note: Forbidden: returning a value for a parameter the server has no value for (neither configured nor a Host Requirements default). TestUnconfiguredParametersOmitted builds a handler with no router, DNS or domain name configured; the negative tag sends a DISCOVER whose parameter request list explicitly names optRouter, optDNS and optDomainName and asserts askedCodes[code] is false for each, so any emitted option for them (including an empty or zero-valued one, since replyOptionCodes records presence by code) goes red. The positive tag asserts the same absence for an unrequested DISCOVER. None of the three has a Host Requirements default, so the ELSE branch applies.
